Dear Madam
I have received all the documents from the Insurance Company & also the policy on [Mrs Yonge](/person/1604)’s life.

As I presume the £1000 is still due to you from Mrs Yonge shall you wish to have the policy transferred into your name so as to afford you a security for the amount of any interest or premiums you have paid, or how would you like to have this arranged.[^1]
I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](/person/2094)
Miss Yonge


[^1]: This relates to a policy on the life of CMY\'s sister-in-law Emma Frances Yonge.
